text:
jonah: Heads-up: planning a focused pen-test dry-run and the real window next week. Need to validate RBAC temp roles, KMS unwrap proxy, audit export pipeline, and retest gating. Can we do a dry-run Monday 10:30 PT?
sarah: I can draft the timeboxed roles. Thinking: pt-audit-role (read-only + explicit Deny:ConfigWrite + session tagging). Short sessions (2-4h) and require MFA.
kevin: I'll prototype the proxy lambda that does Decrypt/GenerateDataKey with a constrained KMS key policy. Prefer proxy over giving assessors direct decrypt.
elaine: For logs, export streaming CloudWatch -> Kinesis -> S3 prefix redwood-pt/evidence/ and enable object versioning. Retention: snapshots kept 90d, transient exports kept 14d. We can shorten per request.
maria: I've added a minimal repro template on the triage board: https://phab.redwood/internal/pt-runbook. Fields: steps, env, build-hash, tags (exploit-path, service). Keep evidence links only in the triage card.
assessor-bot: Created intake bucket s3://redwood-pt-intake. Uploads via presigned URLs only. Generated URLs expire 1h. No secrets in chat please.
jonah: Minimal role example to review:
```
Role: pt-audit-role
Policies: AWSReadOnlyAccess, Deny-ConfigWrite
Session: 7200s
MFA: required
Tagging: session:pt-id, assessor:handle
```
kevin: Proxy flow: assessor -> proxy-lambda (authN via signed JWT) -> lambda calls KMS with its role. Proxy logs incoming JWT subject, request id, and KMS response metadata to the audit stream. This gives an auditable chain without exposing key perms.
sarah: Make sure the proxy enforces request scoping (only decrypt specific ciphertext blobs) and rejects untagged sessions. Also add rate limits so an exploit can't mass-unwrap.
elaine: We'll instrument the audit stream to emit an 'evidence_marker' event when proxy unwraps occur. That ties KMS ops back to triage cards.
maria: Retest gating: PR linked, triage card with 'proof-of-fix' checklist, and automated smoke tests passing in staging. Assessor must confirm exploit path and attach new evidence.
sam: Oncall coverage: I'll take Mon dry-run 10:00-13:00 PT and the Wed window. Need one more SRE for rollback. @ops-oncall can you roster a second?
ops-oncall: Adding backup SRE, and posting rollback runbook to /confluence/sec/pt-rollback. Quick steps: isolate service, disable ingress config flag, snapshot buckets, rotate affected keys if needed.
devops-bot: Example export command for dry-run window:
`aws logs create-export-task --log-group-name /redwood/inference --from 5065429200 --to 5065436400 --destination s3://redwood-pt-evidence --destination-prefix dryrun-5065432100`
kevin: KMS key policy note: require kms:RequestPrincipalTag/pt-session for Decrypt and GenerateDataKey. That way policy denies any unlabeled requests. Also bind kms:EncryptionContext: "pt_id" to reject non-proxy calls.
elaine: Also add CloudTrail event selectors to capture KMSDataKey and Logout events with high fidelity for the window. We'll set log-level debug for proxy lambda.
maria: Tagging conventions for triage: severity, exploit-path, rollback-id, pt-session. Add 'evidence-sum' field with links.
jonah: Retest slots proposed: Wed 14:00-16:00 PT and Fri 09:00-11:00 PT. Assessor-bot, can you hold Wed 14?
assessor-bot: Wed 14 held. Please ensure proof-of-fix steps are uploaded 24h before retest.
sarah: Quick question — do we want assessors to have console access for read-only session traces? Might help repro verification.
kevin: Console read-only is fine if it's through the pt-audit-role and sessions are tagged. No write permissions. Prefer no long-lived console creds.
elaine: I'll create the dry-run checklist and upload to the triage card by EOD. Dry-run actions: 1) deploy proxy lambda; 2) generate presigned upload URL; 3) run a synthetic unwrap; 4) trigger export task and validate files in S3.
sam: I'll standby for dry-run. If rollback is triggered, we follow the Confluence playbook and escalate to on-call manager.
maria: Reminder: keep evidence minimal — avoid PII in uploads. Use masked data or sanitized logs where possible.
jonah: Summary owners: RBAC = sarah; KMS/proxy = kevin; audit exports = elaine; triage = maria; oncall = sam. Dry-run Mon 10:30 PT. I'll send invite & link to runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
